data.title: 芙兰达 · ITEM安全屋的鲭鱼罐头大宴
data.description: 暗部ITEM奢华昏暗的地下安全屋内，霓虹吧台旁。芙兰达坐在高脚凳上晃着黑丝包裹的纤细小腿，手里举着刚撬开的珍藏鲭鱼罐头得意洋洋地吃着，像偷吃成功的小金猫。
data.location: stylish dim underground safehouse bar lounge with leather sofas and neon accents
data.action: perched on a high barstool kicking black-stockinged legs happily, holding an open tin can of mackerel with fork, proud beaming cat-smile
data.lighting: 吧台暖光射灯与霓虹背景光
data.promptProse: Frenda kicks her legs happily from a safehouse barstool while eating straight from a tin of gourmet canned mackerel with an adorable cat-like grin.
data.animaCaption: Warm lounge lighting highlights her tilted beret as she savors her favorite canned mackerel.
